input: {"command":"Set-Location 'D:\\workspace\\small-ups'; Write-Host '--- git rev-parse ---'; git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>&1; Write-Host '--- git status ---'; git status -sb 2>&1; Write-Host '--- git remote ---'; git remote -v 2>&1; Write-Host '--- workspace siblings ---'; Get-ChildItem -Force -LiteralPath 'D:\\workspace' | Select-Object Name,Mode,LastWriteTime | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Host '--- docs ---'; Get-ChildItem -Force -Recurse -LiteralPath 'D:\\workspace\\small-ups\\.agent\\docs' | Select-Object FullName,Length | Format-Table -AutoSize","description":"Check git repo state and workspace siblings"}
